notes: The BF16 baseline uses metadata-packed BF16 forward dispatch and one BF16 return all-to-all.
The forward-only path uses fused Triton INT8 dispatch and retains the BF16 return path.
The roundtrip path additionally quantizes every expert-output row to INT8 with one BF16 scale, sends payload and scale in two return collectives, and dequantizes before weighted combine.
Quality is measured against BF16 and decomposed into forward-only, return-only, and complete roundtrip drift.
Crossovers rotate BF16, forward-only INT8, and roundtrip INT8 through timing positions.
